errors.evidence: The description includes an interpretation of what the chart's data represents (the effect of digital technologies on work intensity). This information is not present in the visible labels of the figure itself (title, axes, legend) and constitutes an interpretation beyond what is explicitly shown.

errors.text_span: zeigen dunkelblau und hellblau jeweils etwa 30 %
errors.evidence: In the 'eher erhöht' category, the dark blue bar ends at the 30% mark, but the light blue bar is visibly shorter, at approximately 29%. Claiming both are at about 30% is factually incorrect and misrepresents the visual data.
